subject: Environmental Systems and Societies
question: Use the productivity data supplied to calculate the efficiency of energy transfer from the producers to the primary consumers.

supplied_texts.title: Grassland ecosystem: gross productivity by trophic level
supplied_texts.text:
Trophic level / gross productivity (kJ m⁻² yr⁻¹)
Producers 1500
Primary consumers 150
Secondary consumers 15
supplied_texts.provenance: data table supplied with the question

response_text:
Efficiency = energy in consumers / energy in producers × 100
= 150 kJ m⁻² yr⁻¹ / 1500 kJ m⁻² yr⁻¹ × 100
= 10 %

About 10% of the energy passes to the next trophic level; the rest is lost mainly as heat from respiration, or remains in uneaten and undigested material.
